args.prompt:
Create ONE 1536x1024 landscape PNG sprite sheet, EXACTLY SIX UNIQUE KFB SLOPS: weird historical sailors, naval soldiers, veteran seamen and seawomen. 3 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS. Six entire characters independently isolated with generous blank TRANSPARENT gutters and safety margin in EVERY cell, no touching or clipping. TRUE transparent empty alpha background everywhere outside the six figures and their props. NO colored/gradient/blurred background, no floor/shadow discs, no scene, no checkerboard painted into image.
The attached ORIGINAL images are actual STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets. First: rich tactile rounded ink splat morphology, thick soft clay lobes/lips and monster teeth. Second: wonderful chunky handmade occupational costume/prop craft, beautifully modeled worn wood, brass, rope and cloth. Do NOT copy their identical angry grins or red eyeballs. NEW subject family, original concepts, each clearly different before clothing. Full continuous FOOTLESS charcoal-black/deep violet ink blob bodies, visible rich handmade plasticine sculpting and subtle fingerprints. Richly round soft volumes, tiny goo droplets, strong asymmetry. Big WHITE/IVORY sclera, RED iris, BLACK pupil; sculpted lids. Broad irregular tooth mouths, not six identical smiles. Warm studio light; clay cartoon theatrical appeal, no generic baby-faced animated-film cuteness. Historical maritime oddballs: faded indigo, bone linen, tarnished brass, rust red, sea-green patina. One or two wonderfully bold readable props per actor, tangible immediate action, playful absurdity without intellectual riddles or clutter.
TOP LEFT: boisterous young deckhand, broad squat splat, worn striped sailor collar and soft white sailor cap tilted sideways, wide laughing mouth with mismatched teeth and exuberant sideways gaze; hugs a huge thick coil of tarred rope with a chunky anchor dangling at its end. Everything softly sculpted clay, rope tactile with bold strands. Complete goo base visible.
TOP CENTER: FEMALE-READ tall lean historic marine grenadier, faded navy bicorne with small rusty red plume, just short navy shoulder cape and brass buttons over continuous goo; furiously indignant one-eye squint and crooked toothy shout, rounded old flintlock musket with wooden stock held upright beside her (not firing), other goo hand on a small black cannonball. Subtle clay lashes, no human body.
TOP RIGHT: ancient salty boatswain, very wide low saggy ink puddle, tiny battered navy knit cap, one heavy sleepy lid and one wide eye, enormous grumpy underbite with sparse teeth, curved ivory clay pipe unlit clamped in lip; both goo hands wrapped around a stubby salt-crusted wooden ship wheel nearly as broad as himself. An oversized barnacle on wheel rim, simple visual maritime weirdness.
BOTTOM LEFT: FEMALE-READ weatherbeaten navigator/captain, compact asymmetric pear blob, burgundy headscarf under battered tricorn, one soft curling goo quiff, skeptical raised lid and knowing closed crooked smile with single fang; holds a long thick brass spyglass to one eye while the other eye looks toward viewer, a small curled chart tucked under other goo arm. Beautiful modeled brass and parchment, no map text.
BOTTOM CENTER: ecstatic old naval gunner, round springy splat with upward goo lobes, small battered red historic naval cap, huge wild delighted toothy cackle, one eye larger than other; cradles a miniature chunky bronze ship cannon like a beloved pet, one hand stroking its rounded barrel, simple wooden carriage attached with two thick wheels, no firing/smoke. Visceral charming absurd cartoon silhouette, not a human torso.
BOTTOM RIGHT: FEMALE-READ veteran dock sailor, broad lopsided goo body, faded mustard sou'wester folded brim, half-lidded utterly unimpressed side-eye, pursed crooked mouth with two protruding teeth; holds a big silver clay fish by its tail, fish bends softly like a wet sock; other hand casually rests on small battered sea chest tucked into her goo side. Minimal selective barnacles and salt wear, no dense detail. Subtle lashes, no breasts/legs.
Keep costumes partial and props secondary to whole ink bodies. No six identical angry brows, no same mouth, no identical hat swaps. Each character stays full and distinct. NO typography, labels, floating punctuation or symbols. Final image MUST have real transparent alpha, use reference backgrounds only as ignored presentation, do not reproduce any background.
